tool.name: Generate Image
tool.description: Generate images from text prompts using DALL-E 3 API. Returns image URLs that can be uploaded to WordPress media library. Supports customizable size, quality, and style parameters for WordPress content creation.

size.description: The size of the generated image. Square (1024x1024) is best for featured images, landscape (1792x1024) for headers, portrait (1024x1792) for sidebars.

style.description: The style of the generated image. 'vivid' produces hyper-real and dramatic images. 'natural' produces more natural, less hyper-real looking images.

prompt.description: A text description of the desired image. Be detailed and specific for best results.

quality.description: The quality of the image. 'hd' creates images with finer details and greater consistency.

nodes.name: Prepare Prompt
nodes.description: Validate input and prepare LLM prompt with image config

nodes.name: Generate Image
nodes.description: Call Gemini model to generate image

nodes.name: Extract Image
nodes.description: Extract image data from LLM response
